messages.text: Idea from German, worth adopting if it fits Detent: Xapiand's public docs site is its E2E suite. Each page shows real requests in ```rest blocks (e.g. `GET /twitter/user/Kronuz`), followed by hidden `<!-- e2e:begin --> ```js pm.test("...", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().name).to.eql(...)) ``` e2e:end -->` assertions. docs_to_postman.py (repo root, ~170 lines) walks the pages in sidebar order and emits a Postman collection; harness/run_all.sh e2e runs it with newman against a fresh node.
